rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides file publishing and sharing capabilities through the Prismism platform. Upload documents, videos, images, or HTML to get tracked shareable links with view analytics, email capture, password protection, and webhook notifications. Supports both a hosted endpoint for zero-install setup and a local stdio transport via npm.
